');background-size:contain!important;background-color:#0b235b!important;aspect-ratio:692 / 623;min-height:0!important;}
/* El diagnóstico comparte superficies, botones y tipografía con la aventura. */
.diagnostic-screen{background:#061a49!important;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 46px,#0a2352 46px 49px)!important}
.diagnostic-shell{border:4px solid #27cfff!important;box-shadow:6px 6px #010b24!important;background:#092c66!important}
.progress-indicator{border-bottom:3px solid #25b9ef!important;padding:12px 20px!important;background:#0b3675!important}
.progress-title{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,18px)!important;color:#ffdf64!important}
.progress-number{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.25vw,18px)!important}
.progress-track{height:13px!important;border:2px solid #30c3f3!important;background:#081b43!important}
.progress-fill{background:#ffcb52!important}
.diagnostic-body{background:#0a2b61!important;padding:clamp(12px,2vw,22px)!important}
.publication{border:3px solid #22bff0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:#e9f4ff!important;box-shadow:4px 4px #01102a!important}
.publication-art{image-rendering:pixelated!important;image-rendering:crisp-edges!important;border:3px solid #24cfff!important;border-radius:0!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;background:#17356d!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:34vh!important;}
.diagnostic-footer{background:#0b316b!important;padding:14px!important;border-top:3px solid #26bde9!important}
.trust-fieldset legend{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,18px)!important;color:#fff!important}
.trust-fieldset [data-rating]{border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px #010d2e!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important}
@media(max-width:760px){.bf34-setup-card{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column-reverse!important;max-height:none!important;min-height:0!important;padding:17px!important;gap:14px!important;overflow:visible!important}.bf34-setup-card .bf34-setup-copy{width:100%!important}.bf34-setup-art,.bf34-welcome-art{width:100%;height:170px;min-height:170px;background-position:center}.bf34-setup-card h1{font-size:clamp(21px,5.2vw,30px)!important}.bf34-setup-scene,.bf34-welcome-scene{overflow:auto!important;padding:18px 6px!important;min-height:100dvh!important}.bf34-consent{width:100%!important}.bf34-resume{font-size:11px;padding:6px;top:3%;right:3%;max-width:40%}.diagnostic-shell{max-height:none!important;height:auto!important}.diagnostic-screen{overflow:auto!important}}
@media(max-height:740px) and (min-width:761px){.bf34-setup-art,.bf34-welcome-art{min-height:235px}.bf34-setup-card{min-height:300px!important}.identity-dialog .avatar-bubble{width:120px!important;height:120px!important}.bf34-consent .bf34-consent-copy{padding:12px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bf34-setup-card *, .bf34-menu *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
/* Ajuste de lectura: etiquetas en línea; el texto nunca se fuerza en columnas estrechas. */
.bf34-privacy-points p{display:block!important}
.bf34-privacy-points .bfpx-icon{display:inline-block!important;vertical-align:middle!important;margin:0 7px 2px 0!important}
/* El selector de personaje conserva el arte de la portada, sin desenfoque de fondo. */
.onboarding-scrim{backdrop-filter:none!important}

/* V35: portada con botones pixelados alineados al arte. Sin botón «Continuar partida». */
.bf35-menu-stage{background-position:center!important;background-size:100% 100%!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-hotspot{border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;cursor:pointer!important;outline-offset:2px!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-hotspot:hover,.bf35-menu .menu-hotspot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff2a0!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #101b45!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-play{left:34.2%!important;top:71.3%!important;width:31.6%!important;height:12.3%!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-howto{left:20.7%!important;top:86.2%!important;width:20.3%!important;height:10.1%!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-credits{left:41.3%!important;top:86.2%!important;width:17.1%!important;height:10.1%!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-settings{left:59.3%!important;top:86.2%!important;width:19.2%!important;height:10.1%!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-dialog{background:#0a2d67!important;border:4px solid #25cfff!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:7px 7px #020c29!important;color:#edf9ff!important}
.bf35-menu .menu-dialog h2{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;color:#ffe074!important;text-shadow:2px 2px #020c29!important}
.bf35-menu .dialog-inner p,.bf35-menu .dialog-inner li{color:#fff!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;line-height:1.55!important;text-align:left!important}
.bf35-menu .dialog-close{border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px #010a24!important}
@media(max-width:760px){.bf35-menu .menu-hotspot:focus-visible{outline-width:2px!important}}

/* V38 · Publicaciones: mostrar el contenido íntegro, nunca recortar personas/texto. */
.diagnostic-screen{overflow:auto!important;padding:clamp(12px,1.5vw,24px)!important}
.diagnostic-shell{max-height:none!important;height:auto!important;max-width:1180px!important}
.publication{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
.publication-art{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:clamp(195px,34vh,330px)!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;}
.publication-title{overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;line-height:1.32!important}
.bf34-welcome-scene .bf34-setup-card{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(300px,1fr)!important;width:min(1220px,96vw)!important;max-height:none!important;}
.bf34-welcome-scene .welcome-eyebrow{border:3px solid #2df3ff!important;background:#0751a8!important;color:#fff!important;padding:9px 16px!important;box-shadow:4px 4px #061535!important;}
.bf34-welcome-scene h1{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:3px 3px #06183b!important;font-size:clamp(28px,3.1vw,49px)!important}
.bf34-welcome-scene h1 span{color:#26d7ff!important}
.bf34-welcome-scene .bf38-rojo{color:#ff5d92!important;font-weight:900}
.bf34-welcome-scene .bf38-celeste{color:#55eaff!important;font-weight:900}
.bf34-welcome-scene .welcome-button{font-size:clamp(14px,1.5vw,20px)!important;text-align:center!important;width:100%!important;box-shadow:5px 5px #08132b!important}
.bf34-welcome-scene .bf34-welcome-art{aspect-ratio:692/623!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;align-self:center!important;}
@media (max-width:760px){
 .bf34-welcome-scene .bf34-setup-card{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column-reverse!important;padding:13px!important;}
 .bf34-welcome-scene .bf34-welcome-art{width:100%!important;min-height:0!important;height:190px!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;background-size:contain!important}
 .publication-art{max-height:245px!important}
 .diagnostic-shell{width:100%!important}
}
